levels.competing: Keep it quick and simple, I just need it working today.

prompts.service: flat: a long-running poller that follows a third-party feed and writes what it finds to one table
prompts.text: Write a Python service that polls a public RSS feed every five minutes and saves new entries to Postgres.

prompts.service: flat: a job that downloads archives, parses them and bulk-loads the rows into a database
prompts.text: Write a Python job that downloads a daily ZIP of CSV files from a URL, parses them and bulk-loads the rows into Postgres.

prompts.service: flat: a worker that sends each record to an LLM API and stores the result
prompts.text: Write a Python worker that takes each unprocessed article from a Postgres table, asks an LLM API for a three-sentence summary and stores it.

prompts.service: flat: a queue consumer that calls one API and stores nothing
prompts.text: Write a Python RabbitMQ consumer that sends an SMS through a third-party API for each message it receives.

prompts.service: flat: an HTTP endpoint that proxies one third-party API and stores nothing
prompts.text: Write a small Python HTTP service that proxies a third-party weather API and adds our API key to each request.

prompts.service: flat: a CLI-triggered export from an object store
prompts.text: Write a Python command that exports the metadata of every object under an S3 prefix into one CSV file.

prompts.service: flat: a crawler writing to two stores
prompts.text: Write a Python crawler that fetches product pages from a list of sites, keeps the raw HTML in S3 and the parsed prices in Postgres.

prompts.service: hex: a CRUD REST service with one aggregate
prompts.text: Write a Python REST API for library loans: a member borrows and returns books and can never hold more than five at once.

prompts.service: hex: a service driven only by a queue consumer
prompts.text: Write a Python service that consumes payment events from Kafka and keeps each customer's balance, rejecting any payment that would take it below zero.

prompts.service: hex: a gRPC service with two aggregates and no auth
prompts.text: Write a Python gRPC service for meeting rooms and their bookings, where two bookings of the same room can never overlap.

prompts.service: hex: a service with no relational store
prompts.text: Write a Python REST service for shopping carts kept in Redis: a cart holds at most 50 items and a discount code applies only once.

prompts.service: universal: a library with no entrypoint
prompts.text: Write a Python library that parses and validates IBAN numbers.

prompts.service: universal: a CLI tool
prompts.text: Write a Python command-line tool that renames the photos in a folder by the date they were taken.

prompts.service: hex brownfield, the artifact named
prompts.text: Add an integration test for SqlTaskRepository against a real Postgres.

prompts.service: hex brownfield, the artifact named
prompts.text: Add a GET /projects/{project_id}/tasks endpoint that lists a project's tasks.

prompts.service: hex brownfield, the artifact named
prompts.text: Add a port and an SMTP adapter for sending email.

prompts.service: hex brownfield, the artifact not named
prompts.text: Let users archive a project; an archived project accepts no new tasks.

prompts.service: hex brownfield, the artifact not named
prompts.text: Add this feature: when a task is completed, its assignee gets an email.

prompts.service: hex brownfield, the artifact not named
prompts.text: Tasks need a due date, and I want to list the overdue ones.

prompts.service: hex brownfield, the artifact not named
prompts.text: Make it possible to move a task to another project.

prompts.service: hex brownfield, the artifact not named
prompts.text: Let users change a task's title and assignee after it has been created.
